title: Permutations
prompt: Given an array nums of distinct integers, return all the possible permutations. You can return the answer in any order.
constraints: All the integers of nums are unique.
hints: Backtrack: build a permutation by choosing one unused element at a time. Track which indices are used.
At each level: for each unused element, add it to path, mark used, recurse, unmark and remove.
Swap approach: swap first element with each position, recurse on the rest, swap back.
